visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with short black hair wearing a blue and white vertically striped shirt sits in a room with white walls. Behind him is a vibrant yellow bookshelf filled with colorful Lego sets, including a replica of the Statue of Liberty and a Japanese-style garden. The man gestures enthusiastically with his hands as he speaks directly to the camera, which is at eye-level. A small animated cartoon graphic of historical horse riders briefly floats over his shoulder. The lighting is bright and even, typical of a studio or well-lit home office. (2) A historical black and white photograph occupies the screen, showing an elderly Asian man with a mustache sitting formally in an ornate wooden chair, wearing a dark suit. The background of the photo is a plain studio curtain. (3) The scene returns to the man in the striped shirt. A small graphic of the Japanese flag and a galloping horse icon appear to his right. He continues to use expressive hand motions, occasionally touching his chest. Floating mathematical icons like 'y=ax+b' and geometric shapes appear briefly around his head. (4) The visuals cut to archival footage of brown horses racing across a green field. The camera focus is on their legs and the dirt kicking up behind them, creating a sense of rapid movement. (5) Back to the man in the striped shirt. He holds up a printed rectangular flyer featuring an illustration of two horse riders in a vintage style with Chinese characters. (6) A shot of the entrance to 'Chenggongling' is shown, featuring a large grey archway with Chinese characters inscribed. Cars are seen exiting the gate onto a paved road lined with trees under a bright, slightly overcast sky. (7) Final segment shows the man pointing downward towards an on-screen graphic of a black smartphone with the word '賽馬' (Horse Racing) and a finger icon, encouraging viewer interaction.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Logo]: 臺灣吧. [Slogan]: 最有畫面感的臺灣史. 粵、動、史、學、台、中、小、學、生、的、歷、史、思、維. [Subtitle]: 你知道你熟悉的. (2) [Subtitle]: 成功嶺營區. (3) [Subtitle]: 以前可不是新兵訓練營. (4) [Subtitle]: 而是賽馬場. (5) [Variety]: 臺灣以前有賽馬?. (6) [Subtitle]: 在日治時期的時候. (7) [Subtitle]: 大家瘋的不得了. (8) [Subtitle]: 連霧峰林家大家長 林獻堂. (9) [Subtitle]: 都愛得要命. (10) [Variety]: 那沒事為什麼要賽馬?. (11) [Subtitle]: 也是為了軍事需求. (12) [Subtitle]: 那時候日本人想要富國強兵. (13) [Subtitle]: 優秀健壯的軍馬很重要. (14) [Subtitle]: 1904 年的時候 就開始鼓勵民間去. (15) [Subtitle]: 培育優秀的馬種. (16) [Subtitle]: 公民就在想 怎麼樣更好培育優秀馬種. (17) [Subtitle]: 賽馬就是一個好的選擇. (18) [Subtitle]: 可以促進大家進行 品種改良. (19) [Subtitle]: 又可以賺錢 一舉兩得. (20) [Subtitle]: 但是辦賽馬有個問題. (21) [Subtitle]: 對於場地的需求很嚴格. (22) [Subtitle]: 非常大片的平坦地才行. (23) [Subtitle]: 當時如果 辦那種短期的賽馬會. (24) [Subtitle]: 要麼選公園 要麼選練兵場. (25) [Subtitle]: 大肚山練兵場 當時被作為賽馬場的選擇. (26) [Subtitle]: 轉型變成了 大肚山競馬場. (27) [Subtitle]: 也就是今天成功嶺的前身. (28) [Variety]: 那為什麼現在都沒有看到人在賽馬. (29) [Subtitle]: 因為政府換了 日治時期結束. (30) [Subtitle]: 戰後行政長官 陳儀政府. (31) [Subtitle]: 認為說 賽馬不好. (32) [Subtitle]: 這賽馬敗壞風氣. (33) [Subtitle]: 嚴格禁絕這項活動. (34) [Subtitle]: 把這個大肚山競馬場給拆了. (35) [Subtitle]: 恢復它本來的軍事用途. (36) [Subtitle]: 就成為今天成功嶺營區. (37) [Variety]: 留言「賽馬」 告訴你更多相關.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio opens with a male voice speaking in a bright, energetic tone with clear articulation. A medium-tempo electronic background music track with a steady, rhythmic beat begins simultaneously. There is a faint studio-clean ambient floor. (2) A sharp 'pop' sound effect, resembling a cartoon bubble burst, triggers as visual graphics appear. The male speaker maintains a consistent pitch and high engagement level. (3) A female voice interjects with a brief, curious question, sounding slightly muffled as if recorded from a different source or filtered to sound like an off-camera participant. The BGM continues steadily underneath. (4) Another transition sound effect, a 'whoosh' followed by a 'ding,' marks a shift in the male speaker's narrative as he begins explaining historical reasons. The BGM's beat becomes more pronounced. (5) The sound of horses' hooves galloping—a rhythmic, percussive thudding with wide spectral bandwidth—is briefly mixed in over the BGM during the horse racing footage. The male voice continues narration over this layer. (6) A final 'ding' sound effect occurs as the speaker makes a concluding point. The BGM swells slightly in volume before fading out as the speaker gives a call to action. The audio is well-balanced with a high signal-to-noise ratio.
